text_en: A Maskil of David. When he was in the cave. A Prayer.
text_cn: 达味的训导诗，避居山洞时的祷词。

text_en: With my voice I cry to the Lord ; with my voice I make supplication to the Lord .
text_cn: 我高声向上主呼求， 我高声向天主求助。

text_en: I pour out my complaint before him; I tell my trouble before him.
text_cn: 我向他倾吐我的愁苦， 我向他陈诉我的忧虑。

text_en: When my spirit is faint, you know my way. In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
text_cn: 当我精神愁苦的时候， 惟有你知悉我的路途。 在我行走的道路中； 他们给我设下陷阱。

text_en: Look on my right hand and see— there is no one who takes notice of me; no refuge remains to me; no one cares for me.
text_cn: 我向右观察细看，没有一个熟悉我的人！ 没有一人我可投奔，没有一人为我操心。

text_en: I cry to you, O Lord ; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living. ”
text_cn: 上主，我今呼号说：你是我的避难所， 在这活人的地方，你就是我的福爵。

text_en: Give heed to my cry, for I am brought very low. Save me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
text_cn: 求你倾听我的哀号， 因我十分可怜无靠， 求你救我脱离迫害我的人， 因他们是比我强悍的人。

text_en: Bring me out of prison, so that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will deal bountifully with me.
text_cn: 求你引领我出离监牢， 好让我赞美你的名号。 义人前呼后拥欢迎我， 因为你大量恩待了我。
